paragraphs.text: From spring 4073 to mid-4077, Gull the Woodcutter led a crusade against wizards in the Domains . It is the subject of the Greensleeves Trilogy of novels.

In 4073 AR , the Stone Brain fell in the woods northwest of White Ridge . Attracted by the object, wizards from across the Domains began converging on the village. A month later, the wizards Dacian and Towser held a duel that caused the destruction of the entire village . Many of the villagers were killed, and almost all remaining villagers decided to relocate elsewhere. Following the massacre, Gull the Woodcutter, one of the survivors, pledged an oath to kill any wizard he met.

Gull and his sister Greensleeves briefly joined the company of Towser, believing that he was not at fault for the destruction. Soon after Towser recovered the Stone Brain , mistaking it for a mana vault, he revealed himself to be the cause of the destruction, transporting Gull away to a tropical island and kidnapping Greensleeves to attempt to steal her power as a nascent wizard.

Gull spent his time on the island organizing the other victims of wizards' magic into a fighting force. He was summoned back to Towser by Lily, who, unbeknownst to herself, was also a wizard. Towser had tied Greensleeves to an altar, and he was ready to kill her, when Kem changed sides, remembering how Gull had saved his life in the bog. At the same time, Greensleeves, who was also revealed to be a wizard, summoned Morven, Stiggur, the centaurs, Liko, and all the creatures of the woods who had befriended her to fight Towser's minions. Still, Towser was a veteran wizard and could control his creatures better than Greensleeves. She resolved to use an earthquake , which destroyed the cliff they were on and plunged them into the sea. Then Greensleeves put her hand in the sea and cast another spell - a tsunami . Towser escaped the great wave with his flight spell, and Gull, Greensleeves, and Stiggur escaped by taking refuge in a crack in the cliffside, while Morven, Kem, and most of Towser's entourage were swept away by the sea. After the water had settled, they found that Lily, the centaurs, and Liko had survived. Gull and his friends vowed to form an army to fight Towser, who Gull now realized was the wizard who had killed his family, and all the evil wizards who saw people as mindless pawns.

The convoy traveled for nine months, picking up more followers and defeating two more wizards, before it was raided by the desert wizard Karli in early winter 4074. Karli killed a third of Gull's force, but was eventually driven off.

After Rakel took command of the army, she immediately began introducing the process. She promoted Donahue from head clerk to quartermaster and organized the soldiers into three companies: red, blue, and green. Each soldier was armed with a lance, shield, and bow. As the army wandered into the Badlands , they were attacked by the wizard Haakon , successfully repelling his forces and destroying his stronghold before capturing him. Rakel was captured and tortured before being saved by Lily and Gull. Greensleeves was successful in planeswalking to Phyrexia, bringing some of her friends with her. The army escaped to the Whispering Woods , where Garth reappeared and they defeated Dacian . The wizard helped the members of the army to return to their homelands, where they reunited with their families and convinced more to join the cause. Helki and Holleb convinced all 50 members of their tribe to join the army, while the red captains found hundreds of soldiers willing to join. After reconciling, Garth and Rakel returned to their vineyard. Realizing the connection they shared through the Stone Brain, Haakon and Dacian began tracking down other wizards defeated by the siblings, recruiting them to a congress of wizards.

With their bolstered numbers, the army formed a community in the Whispering Woods known as Greensleeves's Grove and introduced new units. The Green Company became the Green Lancers, Gull's personal guard. After three assassination attempts against Greensleeves, Gull handpicked Petalia, who handpicked five other women to make up Greensleeves's bodyguard, the Guardians of the Grove. The Guardians were known to be so fierce that they were nicknamed the "Bulldog Bitches" by their comrades. The Red and Blue Companies grew to 100-man Centuries, and were joined by two more, now called the Red Scorpions, the Blue Seals, the White Bears, and the Black Dogs. The cavalry was split into two companies: the Rose Cavalry under Helki and the Gold Cavalry under Holleb. The scouts were placed under Jayne and renamed the Ravens. The army was joined by groups of D'Avenant and elvish archers as well as a troupe of Pradesh nomads .

Over the next three years, the army defeated over a dozen wizards, with Greensleeves tagging Dwen , Fabia , Leechnip , Thunderhead , Gurias , and Immugio . Two others, including Chundachynnowyth, were killed, while a few more escaped.

The survivors of these encounters were each found and contacted by the congress of wizards using their link to the Stone Brain, eventually bolstering its numbers to eleven. Using a copied Nova Pentacle to prevent being controlled and aided by a Keldon warlord, they attacked the army in the Whispering Woods from three directions. Gull was confronted by the warlord, but before the enemy could kill the woodcutter, Greensleeves teleported herself, Gull, and the survivors of their army to their headquarters at Greensleeves' Grove.

After traveling to Lat-Nam to discover the secret of the Stone Brain, they were attacked once again by Towser's wizards. After a long battle , the army retreated into a tunnel where Gull had a prophetic dream about his dead family. Among them, he did not see Sparrow Hawk , their long-lost brother, and had a revelation about the warlord's identity. Towser proposed a truce, to which Gull responded by challenging the warlord to a duel. When Gull revealed to the warlord that the latter was, in truth, Sparrow Hawk, who had been kidnapped and enchanted by Towser to be a war machine, the two brothers reconciled. However, Haakon unleashed a fireball against the two, who were engulfed in flames. This caused Greensleeves to go mad with anger and sorrow, making the "final sacrifice" of her ideal that every life was sacred. She blasted Haakon with a Lightning Bolt , then trapped the other wizards in the desert and summoned a Force of Nature . Absorbing the mana of the creature, the enemy wizards, and that of Lat-Nam itself, Greensleeves became a godlike being and lost herself, seeing her friends and family as mere ants compared to her.

Before she could unleash her overwhelming power and destroy the isle, Greensleeves was brought to her senses by her lover, Kwam, and saw that her brothers had survived Haakon's fireball thanks to the enchanted might of Sparrow Hawk. Greensleeves decided then, instead of annihilating everyone, to pour all of her mana into the Isle of Lat-Nam, curing the land of the poison and transforming the desert into a verdant forest. Healing the land let her release all her pent-up mana harmlessly, which reduced her back to her normal self. This outpouring of mana caused Greensleeves to lose her spark.

In the aftermath of the Battle of Lat-Nam , the surviving evil wizards, stripped of their mana by the Force of Nature, were brought before the druid, who used the secret of the helmet revealed to her by the skull to strip Towser of his magic using the Stone Brain. Seeing how the punishment caused Towser to run away screaming madly, Gull found the solution too drastic and cruel, so he decided to let the other surviving wizards retain their magic, but only for doing good. Greensleeves kept to herself the last secret of the Stone Brain, its ability to give magic to anyone, thinking that a similar power was sure to cause another war for control over it. In the end, the wizards all pledged obedience to Greensleeves, who was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

Hundreds of years later, sensing the return of the plane's greatest enemies, the Phyrexians , Greensleeves was reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods, a being of pure elemental power. The former archdruid swore to protect not just the people of Dominaria, but the land itself.
Gull's army was led by a council, which in 4073 contained:
Wizards: Greensleeves and Lily
Red Captains: Tomas, Varrius
Captain of the Blue Company: Neith
Captain of cavalry: Helki
Chief of scouts: Bardo

Gull banned wagons from his army, as he felt they were too difficult to maneuver over terrain. Soldiers and their spouses carried packs or sacks of food and camp gear. Samite healers carried satchels of unguents, bandages, and herbs. The students of magic dragged a travois topped with chests full of magical artifacts. Most of the soldiers had camp followers: wives, husbands, and children. Many were artisans: blacksmiths, cooks, leatherworkers, and artificers.
At its height in 4077, the army was organized as:
Green Lancers: 20+ soldiers, leader Ordando
Wizards: Greensleeves and Lily Guardians of the Grove: 6 soldiers, leader Petalia Students of magic: 4 students Summons including Elvish archers, 200+ Yotian soldiers, goblins, wolves, etc.
Commander: Varrius Red Scorpions: 100 soldiers, Captain Dionne Blue Seals: 100 soldiers, Captain Neith White Bears: 100 soldiers, Captain Cerise Black Dogs: 100 soldiers, captain unknown
Rose Cavalry: 25 centaurs and 25 horsemen, captain Helki
Gold Cavalry: 25 centaurs and 25 horsemen, Captain Holleb
Ravens: A troupe of Pradesh nomads and other scouts, leader Jayne
Heavy infantry: Stiggur, Dela, Liko, and Knothead
D'Avenant archers: 20+, leader Hermine
Sappers: 30 dwarves, leader Uxmal
Martyrs of Korlis: 54 zealots, leader Nazarius

Camp followers and those referred to as "idlers" continuously flowed in, including cripples, runaways, a Verduran enchantress, 3 Muronian dervishes, a company of cartographers under Kamee, a covey of librarians, leatherworkers, cobblers, armorers, cooks and helpers, freightmasters, woodcutters, nurses, schoolteachers, and a corps of quartermasters.
Late winter 4073: Fall of the Stone Brain
One month later, winter or spring 4073: Battle of White Ridge
One month later, spring 4073: Battle of the burned forest
Spring 4073: Battle with Towser at the monolith
9 months later, Early winter 4073: Karli 's raid. Tomas is killed
Early winter 4073: Rakel and Hammen are kidnapped to Benalia and she is sent to assassinate Gull and Greensleeves
Last days of 4073: Greensleeves trains for 5 years in suspended time with Chaney
Weeks later, winter 4074: Ambush in the Badlands
Winter 4074: Assault on Haakon's stronghold
~50 days after Karli's raid, winter 4074: Phyrexian gremlins take the Stone Brain. Rakel is recaptured. Gull, Greensleeves, Lily , Bardo , Ordando , Kwam , and Stiggur pursue
Late winter 4074: Rakel and Hammen are rescued. Bardo, Ordando, and Sabriam are killed. The Stone Brain is recovered. Dacian is defeated. Garth returns. Dacian and Haakon form the Congress of Wizards
4074-4076: Greensleeves captures Dwen , Fabia , Leechnip , Ludoc , and Thunderhead .
Winter 4074-4076: Greensleeves captures Gurias .
Autumn 4075-4076: Battle of Myrion . Greensleeves captures Immugio .
4075-4077: Chundachynnowyth dies.
Summer 4077: Dwen, Fabia, Gurias, Immugio, Karli, Ludoc, Leechnip, Thunderhead, and Towser join the Congress of Wizards.
Summer 4077: The congress ambushes the army at Greensleeves's Grove. Gurias and Petalia are killed.

3 months later, 4077: Battle of Lat-Nam . Dacian, Haakon, Leechnip, and Thunderhead are killed. Greensleeves gives up her planeswalker spark and takes Towser's magic. The remaining wizards pledge allegiance to Greensleeves.
